style: Rectangular grey concrete brutalism, bright grey fog. The ragdoll is a faceless segmented mannequin of matte medium grey plastic. Faint crimson blood stains, rare yellow and black hazard stripes. Palette strictly greyscale with rare crimson and hazard-yellow accents.
notes: Rewrite (2026-10). Images 1-4 are kept from the 2025 page; their prompts are the originals, trimmed, kept as a record and not meant to be regenerated (they were made with a different preset). The page had no story image, so only image 5 is new: gen "Custom Dismount" --only 5, then finish "Custom Dismount" --only 5.

images.prompt: Wide-angle cinematic shot from a low angle of a segmented, faceless matte grey plastic ragdoll in a mid-fall pose between massive rectangular grey concrete crusher plates and angular mechanical hazards, bright grey fog, faint blood stains on the floor.

Close dynamic shot of a faceless segmented matte grey plastic ragdoll colliding with a sharply angled grey concrete wall at speed, concrete fragments flying, a faint blood splatter, bright grey fog, a single red hazard light.

Medium shot from a slightly elevated angle of a faceless matte grey plastic ragdoll standing on a concrete path between cubes and ramps, translucent white wireframe ghosts of the same figure stretching ahead along glowing prediction lines into bright grey fog.
Portrait cover of a faceless segmented matte grey plastic ragdoll falling in front of looming grey concrete blocks and a dark conveyor, bright grey fog, faint blood stains on the concrete.

High wide aerial view of a vast flat plain of plain grey concrete fading into bright grey fog, dotted with separate hazard stations built from simple untextured primitive blocks, like an outdoor test range: a long concrete staircase, a train platform with a boxy train on straight rails, a straight road with a boxy truck, a giant fan with dull blades, a tall vertical board studded with rows of short horizontal bars, a hydraulic press over a square pad, and a mine cart track running into a low tunnel. Thin concrete paths connect the stations. A tiny faceless grey mannequin figure stands alone at the top of the staircase.
